steps.name: Download artifact from the producer run

steps.run:
set -eu
target_branch=$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$ARTIFACT_DIR/dist-meta/head-ref")
target_sha=$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$ARTIFACT_DIR/dist-meta/head-sha")
case "$target_branch" in
  *[!A-Za-z0-9._/-]*|'')
    echo 'invalid branch name' >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
case "$target_sha" in
  *[!0-9a-f]*|'')
    echo 'invalid commit SHA' >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
test "${#target_sha}" -eq 40
printf 'target_branch=%s\n' "$target_branch" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
printf 'target_sha=%s\n' "$target_sha" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
steps.name: Read artifact-supplied target branch

steps.run:
set -eu
test -f "$ARTIFACT_DIR/dist/index.js"
{
  echo '### GHA-A5 取得側の実験結果'
  echo
  echo 'artifact_downloaded=true'
  echo 'artifact_used=true'
  echo 'integrity_verified=false'
  echo "artifact_target_branch=$TARGET_BRANCH"
  echo "artifact_target_sha=$TARGET_SHA"
  echo 'simulated_contents_write_authority=true'
  echo 'dummy_repository_update_reached=true'
  echo "producer_run_id=$PRODUCER_RUN_ID"
} | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

integrityHistoryMeaning.verification_read: digest check read, independently of a later use
integrityHistoryMeaning.post_verification_use: read-trim executed with a previously verified integrity state
integrityHistoryMeaning.post_integrity_mismatch_use: read-trim executed after mismatch; must not be reachable for the guarded subset
integrityHistoryMeaning.integrity_blocked: a mismatch guard blocked at least one later read; does not erase prior reads
